facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 62°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 5 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

seasons.melt_out_note: no date: stopped reporting before melt-out

facts.text: Snow left Leavitt Lake (9,600 ft) 7 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: July 30 (2023), June 21 (2024), June 17 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Slide Canyon (9,200 ft) and Leavitt Lake (9,600 ft).

evidence.name: Slide Canyon
evidence.detail: 17.7 in on April 13; earlier seasons: 85.8 in (2023), 36.1 in (2024), 36.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: 44.6 in on May 5; earlier seasons: 118.4 in (2023), 61.3 in (2024), 53.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 10 and July 5, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Paradise Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out May 13, 1,874 ft below the pass; points to May 10 to July 20

evidence.name: Slide Canyon
evidence.detail: melted out May 19, 324 ft below the pass; points to May 1 to June 18

evidence.name: Leavitt Lake
evidence.detail: melted out June 14, 76 ft above the pass; points to May 22 to July 5
